chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Palate your children with dates; thus did the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) do with Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)
key_terms.التَّمْرِ: With dates (the substance used for the ritual)
key_terms.حَنِّكُوا: Palate your children (a ritual anointing of the newborn's palate)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic practice of blessing a newborn with dates?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes *takhnik* as a recommended Sunnah, linking the practice of anointing a newborn's palate with crushed dates to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and Imam Ali (peace be upon him). It highlights the continuity of prophetic tradition in nurturing the physical and spiritual well-being of children, emphasizing the sanctity of the family unit in Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Palate your children with the dates, (for) like this is what the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> did with Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid from abu Basir who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Feed your newborn children dates because the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, did so with al-Hassan and al- Husayn, ‘Alayhim al-Salam.”’
